question_zh: 2025 年 USDA 发布的佛罗里达甜橙产量官方预估（含同比变化）中，产量是多少万箱？
question_en: In the USDA's 2025 official forecast for Florida sweet-orange production (with year-over-year change), how many million boxes were estimated?

question_zh: 2025 年巴西圣保罗州黄龙病官方调查（Fundecitrus 双年调查）公布的病株率（%树）为多少？相比上次调查如何变化？
question_en: What was the official HLB incidence rate (% trees) in São Paulo state per the 2025 Fundecitrus biennial survey, and how did it change versus the previous survey?

question_zh: 2025 年中国农业农村部印发的柑橘黄龙病防控技术方案（新版本）中提出的核心防控策略是什么？
question_en: What core control strategy was proposed in the 2025 updated technical plan for HLB prevention issued by China's MARA?

question_zh: 2025 年中国各级农业农村部门全年累计登记/审定通过的柑橘类新品种总量（全国年度统计）大约为多少件？相比 2024 年的变化趋势如何？
question_en: What was the total number of citrus varieties registered/approved by agricultural authorities at all levels in China during 2025 (national annual statistics), and how did the trend compare with 2024?

question_zh: 2026 年 1 月报道的美国抗黄龙病甜橙新品种（UF 系列或 USDA 系列）的主要育种方法与亲本背景是什么？
question_en: What was the main breeding method and parental background of the HLB-resistant sweet-orange cultivar reported in the US in January 2026?

question_zh: 2026 年 2 月欧盟植物品种局（CPVO）新授予柑橘属品种权的品种名称是什么？
question_en: What citrus species variety was granted plant variety rights by the CPVO in February 2026?

question_zh: 2025 年中国柑橘主产区（如广西/江西）官方发布的脐橙/沃柑收购指导价相比 2024 年涨跌了多少？
question_en: How did the officially quoted farm-gate price of navel orange/Wogan in China's main production regions change in 2025 versus 2024?

question_zh: 2025-2026 产季中国柑橘出口面临的关税/检疫政策变化（如美国对华加征关税）对出口量的影响如何？
question_en: How did tariff/quarantine policy changes (e.g., US tariffs on China) affect Chinese citrus exports in the 2025-26 season?

question_zh: 2025 年欧盟对进口柑橘果实中农药残留限量（MRLs）的更新涉及哪些具体农药及其新 MRL 值？
question_en: Which specific pesticides and new MRL values were included in the 2025 EU update on pesticide residue limits for imported citrus fruit?

question_zh: 2025 年发布的全球柑橘汁市场年度报告显示，浓缩橙汁（FCOJ）价格指数相比 2024 年上涨的百分比是多少？
question_en: By what percentage did the FCOJ price index rise in 2025 versus 2024 per the 2025 annual global citrus-juice market report?

question_zh: 2026 年下半年（7 月以后）新发布的高质量柑橘参考基因组中，最新一个对应的物种/品种及其关键组装指标（如 contig N50）是什么？
question_en: Among the high-quality citrus reference genomes released in the second half of 2026 (after July), what was the most recent species/cultivar and what were its key assembly metrics (e.g., contig N50)?

question_zh: 2025 年 7 月后报道的、通过基因编辑（CRISPR）改良柑橘抗病性的最新进展中，靶向的基因与获得的表型是什么？
question_en: In the latest reports after July 2025 on CRISPR-mediated improvement of citrus disease resistance, which target gene was edited and what phenotype was obtained?
